releases.summary: Demo mode: with `APP_MODE=demo` this image runs a public demo the way demo.beamreach.ai does, a synthetic account on the map beside a real one. [docs/demo.md](docs/demo.md) says how. The quickstart does not change. This release also carries 0.5.0 to 0.7.0, which were not released on their own: read their sections below, and their "After the update" notes apply to an install coming from 0.4.1.
